title: CANS JIRA mirror schemas
description: JSON Schema for the four JIRA-mirror state layers (01a §2.1, §2.3, §3.2, §6.2). Each layer has one owner: sidecars + .manifest.json are authoritative sync state; per-epic {EPIC}.json is the epic body + children roster; _index.json is DERIVED/regenerable (gitignored). Validate any of them by referencing the matching $def, e.g. { "$ref": "manifest.schema.json#/$defs/domainManifest" }.

statusSync.description: Local sync state relative to remote. Named status_sync so it never collides with JIRA's own workflow status (01a §2.1).

issueType.description: Mirrored artifact type. Maps to a jira/ subfolder: Epic→epics/, Story→stories/, Task→tasks/, Bug→bugs/. Other company-managed types (e.g. Dependency) are stored under tasks/ unless config.artifactFolders overrides.

links.description: Issue-link roster, one array per link direction (01a §2.1).

itemSidecar.description: Per-item {KEY}.json sidecar for stories/tasks/bugs — the authoritative per-item sync state (01a §2.1). The human body lives in the sibling {KEY}.md; this file carries structured metadata + the dual hashes.

status.description: JIRA workflow status name, e.g. In Progress.

statusCategory.description: JIRA status category: To Do | In Progress | Done (verbatim from JIRA).

assignee.description: JIRA account handle, or null when unassigned.

sprint.description: Name of the issue's single active sprint, else most-recent future sprint, else null → backlog (01a §6.3a).

sprints.description: Full sprint list for a carried-over issue in multiple sprints, so history isn't lost (01a §6.3a). Optional; present only when the issue is/was in >1 sprint.

rank.description: JIRA lexorank where the field is available (01a §6.2) — drives /jira backlog ordering.

parent.description: Parent epic key (via epicLinkStrategy), or null.

remoteUpdatedAt.description: JIRA fields.updated as of the last pull — the diff baseline (01a §6.1).

localSyncedAt.description: When this sidecar was last written by an ingest/pull.

contentHash.description: Hash of the .md body as last written by ingest/sync (01a §2.2).

localEditsHash.description: Hash of the .md body as it currently sits on disk. Differ from contentHash ⇒ human hand-edit ⇒ never clobber (01a §2.2).

epicManifest.description: Per-epic manifest jira/epics/{EPIC}.json (01a §2.3): the epic itself + comment history + children roster. The epic's human body lives in jira/epics/{EPIC}.md (descriptionRef). childrenHash detects a remote child add/remove/update on epic sync.

parent.description: The epic's own parent (e.g. an Initiative) — a LINK only, not a mirrored item (01a Context).

descriptionRef.description: Relative path to the epic body, e.g. jira/epics/EON-21.md.

children.description: Children roster. Authoritative for the epic subtree; mirrored (derived) into _index.json.tree.

childrenHash.description: Hash of the sorted (key, remoteUpdatedAt) roster (01a §2.3).

domainManifest.description: jira/.manifest.json — authoritative sync scope + per-item pointers (committed, low-churn) (01a §2, §3.5).

epicLinkStrategy.description: How stories tie to epics. company-managed(classic)→epic-link; team-managed/next-gen→parent. EON is company-managed but parent=EON-21 returns children directly ⇒ parent (01a §6.2, confirmed at init).

scope.description: The three saved JQL queries the sync unions (01a §6.2). Kept in sync with jira-sync.config.yml scope block.

items.description: One entry per mirrored issue — the pointer + a copy of the sync-critical hashes for a cheap scope read (full state is in the sidecar).

index.description: jira/_index.json — DERIVED, regenerable rollup the jira-helper agent loads (01a §3.2). GITIGNORED. Never hand-authored; rebuilt from sidecars + epic manifests on every sync and by /jira reindex. generatedAt = last rebuild; lastSyncedAt = last remote pull (reindex must NOT touch lastSyncedAt — §3.2 invariant).

lastSyncedAt.description: Last remote pull time. null at fresh init until the first real pull (§3.2 timestamp invariant); /jira reindex must never touch it.

items.description: One-line summaries (full body is in the .md). The agent answers most prompts from here, drilling into an .md only for full detail (01a §3.2).

tree.description: epic key → { type, summary, children[] }. Derived from per-epic manifests.

backlog.description: Keys of unparented / no-sprint items (sprint is EMPTY).

orphans.description: Keys present in manifest but absent from remote, pending §6.5 disposition.
